standard_references.evidence: Fetched official-source excerpt identifies SDMX Glossary Version 2.1 and includes entries for Metadata Set, Metadata Structure Definition, Metadata update, Institutional mandate, Education level, and Geographical coverage; the excerpt also confirms cross-domain concept ID COVERAGE_GEO with recommended representation String; Codelist.

The supplied principles identify this guideline as the SDMX reference metadata guideline and as a source for a standard list of reference metadata concepts; no fetched excerpt in the supplied context confirms the exact concept inventory or version details beyond the citation.

The supplied principles identify the SDMX 2.0 Information Model as the formal source for SDMX 2.0 artefact definitions, including metadata structures and metadata sets; no fetched excerpt in the supplied context confirms detailed metadata-set mechanics.

Fetched official-source excerpt shows the SDMX Global Registry interface with Codelists and Metadata Structures among searchable artefact types; it does not confirm any education-specific metadata concept or codelist for this report.

The shared source catalog lists UNESCO ISCED as the authoritative source to check for education level classifications. No fetched external excerpt confirming applicable ISCED codes or revision was supplied.

limitations: The supplied report context does not state contact information, geographic coverage, source URL, legal or institutional mandate, or a metadata update date distinct from the publication date; these gaps are not converted into evidence-bearing metadata values.

The exact SDMX Global Reference Metadata Concept Scheme artefact ID and version were not confirmed from supplied external evidence for most metadata concepts; the metadata set therefore uses the accepted local MSD concept IDs and preserves SDMX mappings as candidate where appropriate.
The metadata-set target identifiers for dataflows and datasets are local identifiers because no accepted DATAFLOW or DATASET artifact was supplied in this prompt.
Education-level labels require ISCED mapping review, so no confirmed ISCED mapping is asserted in this metadata set.
Wealth quintiles are survey-specific according to the report and are not silently mapped to a standard income classification.

Enrollment and completion are kept as separate dataflow-level metadata targets because the report states different methods and source semantics for administrative enrollment headcounts and modelled household-survey completion estimates.
Dataset-level status footnotes are represented separately from dataflow-level metadata to match the accepted MSD target attachment for STATUS_NOTE.
